description: This file defines the Faq class for managing FAQ entries within the vtiger CRM system, including methods for handling comments, generating report queries, and managing related tables.

classes.name: Faq
classes.description: Represents FAQ entries in the CRM, with methods for comment management, report query generation, and relation handling.

methods.name: Faq
methods.description: Constructor that initializes logging, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Saves the FAQ module data and inserts associated comments.

methods.name: insertIntoFAQCommentTable
methods.description: Inserts a comment into the vtiger_faqcomments table for a specific FAQ.

methods.name: getFAQComments
methods.description: Retrieves and formats comments related to a specific FAQ as HTML.

methods.name: generateReportsQuery
methods.description: Generates the primary SQL query part for reporting on FAQs.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation table info for related modules like Documents.

methods.name: clearSingletonSaveFields
methods.description: Clears the comments field in the column_fields array.
